name: PSL27
description: the simple group $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 7) \cong \mathrm{GL}(3, 2)$, acting on the $7$ points of the Fano plane
identification: $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 7)$ is the only transitive group of degree $7$ of that order.

notes.realizable: The polynomial $x^7 - 7x + 3$ has Galois group $\mathrm{PSL}(2, 7)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ (Trinks; Erbach, Fischer and McKay).

references.title: D. W. Erbach, J. Fischer and J. McKay, Polynomials with PSL(2,7) as Galois group, J. Number Theory 11 (1979)
